title: WeatherBridge: Forecast-Aware Multi-Source Input Adaptation for Pretrained Weather Forecasting Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14863v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data-driven weather forecasting models are commonly trained on ERA5, yet operational deployment must use timely initial states from physics-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems whose distributions differ substantially from ERA5. Direct initialization with these states can degrade autoregressive forecasts, motivating input adaptation that keeps the pretrained forecasting model unchanged. Here, we introduce WeatherBridge, a unified, source-conditioned adapter that maps heterogeneous operational NWP initial states to ERA5 reference states without updating the pretrained forecasting model. WeatherBridge predicts the structured residual corrections with a Swin-UNet and injects source embeddings across multiple spatial scales, allowing the model to capture shared atmospheric structure and source-specific discrepancies. translated_abstract: 数据驱动的天气预报模型通常基于ERA5进行训练，但在实际业务部署中必须使用来自物理数值天气预报（NWP）系统的及时初始状态，而这些状态的分布与ERA5存在显著差异。直接使用这些状态进行初始化可能会降低自回归预报的质量，因此需要一种保持预训练预报模型不变的输入自适应方法。在此，我们提出WeatherBridge，这是一个统一的、基于源条件化的适配器，能够将异构的业务NWP初始状态映射到ERA5参考状态，而无需更新预训练的预报模型。WeatherBridge利用Swin-UNet预测结构化的残差修正，并在多个空间尺度上注入源嵌入，使模型能够同时捕捉共享的大气结构和特定来源的差异。其训练目标将纬度加权的ERA5重建与一步滚动对齐（ORA）相结合，从而
tldr: 提出WeatherBridge——一个无需修改预训练天气预报模型的源条件化适配器，通过Swin-UNet结构化残差修正与多尺度源嵌入，将异构业务NWP初始状态映射到ERA5参考状态，并结合一步滚动对齐训练目标提升自回归预报质量。
en_tdlr: WeatherBridge is a source-conditioned adapter that maps heterogeneous operational NWP initial states to ERA5 reference states without updating the pretrained forecasting model, using a Swin-UNet for structured residual correction, multi-scale source embeddings, and a One-step Rollout Alignment training objective.
